lanes.title: Freeze the live ECBench inventory
lanes.mechanism: Use the native optimization inventory and require-all audit so every registered method, system solver, PDP3 engine, and prime-tower engine comes from source rather than a stale hand list.
lanes.target: src/cryptanalysis/ecbench/optimization.rs; ecbench optimize inventory --json; ecbench optimize audit --require-all
lanes.deterministic_falsifier: Any registered method or nested algorithm missing from the policy inventory or require-all development coverage makes the audit fail.
lanes.measurement_gate: Inventory is descriptive only; promotion still needs fresh holdout, symmetric pricing, replay, and validation.

lanes.title: Integrate GHS strong rho as an ECBench method
lanes.mechanism: Add a versioned restricted-family strong-rho method with counted and counter-free implementations, exclusive phases, authority fields, and source-bound identity.
lanes.deterministic_falsifier: Plan, run, or replay accepts false count authority, loses a phase, changes the planted scalar, or permits a non-GHS curve.
lanes.measurement_gate: Cold one-target records, counted/native parity, full replay, and L2 admission.

lanes.title: Freeze matched GHS IC and rho controls
lanes.mechanism: Bind the same restricted E0 over Fq3 instances and targets to optimized strong rho, plain rho, negation rho, and B0 S L0 L1 L D DL1 DL IC arms.
lanes.deterministic_falsifier: An arm changes curve, subgroup, target, seed, cache policy, unit, or omits a failed attempt.
lanes.measurement_gate: All eleven q sizes, seeds 1-3, frozen repetitions, cold records, and full pricing band.

lanes.title: Run F4 and Faugere-Lachartre F4 arms
lanes.mechanism: Hold factor base and query stream fixed while comparing full F4 and its reducer/free-column split with preprocessing, matrix construction, elimination, extraction, and witness work retained.
lanes.deterministic_falsifier: Different systems, missing preprocessing, unequal solution sets, failed witness replay, or solver-local counts presented as pipeline cost.
lanes.measurement_gate: Complete cold pipeline, identical inputs, five matched L2 rounds, A/A admission, and fastest external equal-output reference.

lanes.title: Run signature F5 arms
lanes.mechanism: Compare matrix F5 signature suppression with matched F4 while retaining matrix build, signatures, reduction, extraction, and witness costs.
lanes.target: src/cryptanalysis/ic_framework/solvers.rs matrix-f5; PDP3 matrix-f5; PKM sig-f5
lanes.deterministic_falsifier: Smaller word-XOR count without complete construction, changed input tree, or a solution-set mismatch.
lanes.measurement_gate: Same-system external equality, complete cold pipeline, paired holdout, and qualified pricing.

lanes.title: Run F6 and F6-IC arms
lanes.mechanism: Measure F6-IC, F6-IC pair, and prime-tower F6 with support closure, residual arithmetic, sign lifts, witness replay, and solver work visible.
lanes.deterministic_falsifier: Omitted geometric additions, exhaustion treated as UNSAT, different queries, or partial native counts cross-ranked as total cost.
lanes.measurement_gate: Verified attempts, matched cold holdout, external equality where available, replay, and validation.

lanes.title: Run SAT CDCL and sound WD-SAT controls
lanes.mechanism: Run SAT-CDCL with pinned CNF or native-XOR settings and admit WD-SAT only behind an exhaustive truth-set soundness gate rejecting false UNSAT.
lanes.target: src/cryptanalysis/ic_framework/solvers.rs sat-cdcl; src/cryptanalysis/wdsat_oracle.rs; ecbench solver specs
lanes.deterministic_falsifier: One false UNSAT, unchecked model, timeout mapped to no-solution, hidden encoding change, or missing solver settings.
lanes.measurement_gate: Soundness passes first; then full cold recovery pipeline, holdout, replay, and priced/unpriced separation.

lanes.title: Run FES Gray-code and guess-and-determine arms
lanes.mechanism: Compare scalar, GPU, and wide FES plus bounded Gray enumeration and fixed guesses on identical systems while preserving order and CPU re-verification.
lanes.target: src/cryptanalysis/ic_framework/solvers.rs fes-f2 fes-f2-gpu fes-f2-wide exhaustive; method guess parameter
lanes.deterministic_falsifier: Missing solution, incomplete worker output called UNSAT, changed first-solution order, hidden fallback, or omitted setup.
lanes.measurement_gate: Answer parity, complete cold pipeline, host capsule, matched holdout, and applicable external equality.

lanes.title: Run all root-finding engines
lanes.mechanism: Cover MITM, pairs, subtract, full-window, negation-folded, and prime-tower roots against identical pair-table and algebraic controls.
lanes.target: src/cryptanalysis/ic_framework/rootfind.rs; PDP3 rootfind engines; ecbench rootfind specs
lanes.deterministic_falsifier: Different query streams called direct, unchecked root, uncharged table, or complete count divided by an algebraic lower bound and called speedup.
lanes.measurement_gate: Cold recovery, root replay, memory and native counters, paired holdout, and FLINT NTL or Magma reference for fastest claims.

lanes.title: Bind fastest external equal-output references
lanes.mechanism: Export identical systems or roots and bind versions and hashes for Magma, msolve, FGb, M4GB, FLINT, NTL, and other applicable tools.
lanes.target: gb_cas_export; M4GB_BINARY; external command cards and logs
lanes.deterministic_falsifier: Different order or field equations, unpinned executable, unequal outputs, warm-vs-cold mismatch, or inferred external performance.
lanes.measurement_gate: Same host and inputs, cold boundary, checked equality, retained logs and hashes, and five matched rounds for timing.

lanes.title: Enforce complete cold one-target accounting
lanes.mechanism: Require exclusive setup, relation/search, linear algebra, recovery, internal verification, and process windows; report online separately and name every unpriced counter.
lanes.target: src/cryptanalysis/ecbench/runner.rs; docs/ecbench/README.md sections 3 and 7; plans and records
lanes.deterministic_falsifier: Phase sums differ, missing work becomes zero, reusable setup leaks into online claims, verification disappears, or unlike units are cross-ranked.
lanes.measurement_gate: Audit and replay reproduce every charged and unpriced field; cold_end_to_end is the promotion denominator.

lanes.title: Admit host calibration and A-A controls
lanes.mechanism: Require L2 isolation, source-bound host capsule, calibration ratio in the frozen interval, same-target A/A pairs, positive controls, placement, and checkpoint admission.
lanes.deterministic_falsifier: Unknown identity or budget, ratio outside 0.75-1.15, noisy A/A, placement failure, source mismatch, or missing raw data.
lanes.measurement_gate: Every admission field passes before candidate timing; failure admits no wall ranking.

lanes.title: Separate adaptive development from frozen holdout
lanes.mechanism: Use require-all development coverage, freeze the candidate, then evaluate disjoint targets and seeds once on confirmatory holdout specs.
lanes.deterministic_falsifier: Holdout appears in development, cap is tuned as speed knob, override changes identity, or holdout triggers retuning and reuse.
lanes.measurement_gate: Optimize audit exits zero, development covers required live entries, and holdout passes unchanged.

lanes.title: Compute matched uncertainty and multiplicity
lanes.mechanism: Use paired targets, frozen repetitions, clustered bootstrap with ten thousand resamples, censoring rules, and Holm correction over attempts.
lanes.target: ecbench compare calibrate band; immutable analysis receipt
lanes.deterministic_falsifier: Unpaired ratios, dropped timeout, missing-to-zero conversion, wrong resampling unit, post-hoc seeds, or uncorrected multiple claims.
lanes.measurement_gate: Predeclared cold interval excludes parity and A/A noise; independent recompute agrees.

lanes.title: Produce replay validation and PCC chain
lanes.mechanism: Replay all records, independently recompute headlines, bind strongest matched rho and pricing band, then create hash-pinned PCC claims eligible for CI verdict.
lanes.target: ecbench verify --replay-all; VALIDATION.json; replay certificate; validator report; pcc claims
lanes.deterministic_falsifier: Subset replay, producer independence flag, hash mismatch, scalar failure, stale rho, incomplete band, or unsigned claim standing.
lanes.measurement_gate: Validation reports valid and PCC standing comes from the trusted verifier; otherwise evidence remains unverified.

lanes.title: Publish benchmark report and frontier rows
lanes.mechanism: Close bench records, generate source-linked visual and PDF reports, update progress, then regenerate leaderboard twins only for R98-admitted rows with restricted scope.
lanes.target: benchmarks records and progress; IC leaderboard twins; backend leaderboard views
lanes.deterministic_falsifier: Planned result enters board, twins diverge, raw object absent, record open or edited, scope generalized, or failed arm hidden.
lanes.measurement_gate: Bench-record, recompute, validation, replay, artifact, PCC, and publication checks pass from reviewed commit.
